props.name: avatar
props.description:
Avatar to render in the leading slot. Used when there's no explicit
`leadingIcon`/`icon` to show.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Shorthand iconify name. Renders as `trailingIcon` when `trailing` is true,
otherwise as `leadingIcon`. Explicit `leadingIcon`/`trailingIcon` props win.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label. Overridden by the default slot if provided.

props.name: leading
props.description: Position flag for the `icon` shorthand (leading slot).

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the leading side.

props.name: square
props.description: Equal padding on all sides — for icon-only / avatar-only badges.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Position flag for the `icon` shorthand (trailing slot).

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the trailing side.
